text_block_list.text:
—A few days before the Aoba Sho. It was 
the day we intended to hold our pre-race 
meeting with Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Sakura Chiyono O crosses the line! Did 
Sakura Chiyono O just edge them out?!"

In the trainer's office, Mejiro Ardan was 
earnestly studying race footage for 
research...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching Chiyono O-san's and 
Yaeno-san's recent runs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Both of you put on fantastic performances 
in your recent races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: So much so that I found myself captivated—

With her target race drawing near, this 
was the first time I had ever seen Mejiro 
Ardan show such concern for another 
Umamusume.

"Perhaps Sakura Chiyono O and the others 
are truly that special to her—"
choice_data_list:
We'll be facing each other after the Aoba 
Sho.

We'll be facing each other after the Aoba 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. They will... without a doubt, run 
in the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, my 'present' lies in the Aoba 
Sho, and the one I must aim for and 
surpass is—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Nothing less than the prestige of a crown 
jewel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I let my mind wander for a moment, 
didn't I? Let's refocus and begin the 
meeting.

With that, Mejiro Ardan turned off the TV 
that was playing—
—And then came the day of the Aoba Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Preparations are complete. I am ready 
whenever you are.
choice_data_list: Let's get a result that leads to the Derby

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Without growing complacent, I will 
give everything to the "now," true to 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well then— I shall be on my way.
